how_counted: a known problem is a failure or wasted step that a stored lesson describes
a hit is one tool call that ran into it; a hit costs about one model turn
seconds are the whole command's run time, which for combined commands includes other work
a lesson counts as existing before a run when it became readable before the run's first tool call (the lesson id carries that time)
recalled means one of the run's recall results listed the lesson, directly or as a linked memory
the list of problems grows: when a lesson saved during a later issue describes a problem, the problem is added and counted in every issue, including the ones before that lesson existed
